extra.final_summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Torgersen 39.39, Biscoe 38.80, Dream 37.43 (20 Adelie rows used after cleaning).

Data problems found and fixed:
- 3 island labels with stray spaces ("Biscoe ", " Biscoe") — merged into "Biscoe" via normalize_labels.
- 2 exact duplicate rows (7, 11) — removed with approval so they wouldn't double-count in the average.

Issues noted but not fixed (they don't affect this question): one negative flipper_length_mm (-187, out of the 170–235 range, row 21), and body_mass_g values stored as text with commas or out-of-range magnitudes (e.g. 3,800,000 g). bill_length_mm itself was clean (all within 30–60 mm, no missing values).
